changeSet.sql: UPDATE data_table_webhook SET workflow_execution_id = CASE WHEN length(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(url, '[?#].*$', ''), '^.*/webhooks/', '')) <= 512 THEN regexp_replace(regexp_replace(url, '[?#].*$', ''), '^.*/webhooks/', '') END

changeSet.author: Ivica Cardic
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM data_table_webhook WHERE workflow_execution_id IS NULL OR NOT regexp_like(workflow_execution_id, '^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$')
DELETE FROM data_table_webhook WHERE id NOT IN ( SELECT MAX(id) FROM data_table_webhook GROUP BY data_table_id, type, workflow_execution_id, environment)
